submittedParameters.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit image1 ONLY its head and ponytail. It is the same 06 boy but head is too large and high for this crouched run frame.
Reduce the brown head/hair about10% relative to the UNCHANGED torso and boots. Redraw the brown ponytail so its very top is 12% from canvas top, not5%. Keep chin attached naturally to its existing neck. Head must stay huge and round in Q style, but match the head-size-to-short-torso ratio of image3 east idle. Do not scale or move the whole character. Keep all pixels below the neck, two hands, arms, staff, plaque, knees, ankles and corrected side-profile boots UNCHANGED. Preserve current sole level. This is head anatomy correction, not camera zoom.
Images2/3 identity/east idle, image4 approved painterly style. Image5 pose-only girl's aligned east boots: keep the corrected east boots from image1, no outward toe rotation, no girl identity.
Do not change face expression, brown colors, golden hair ribbons/beads, outfit, props or crouch. Same whole canvas. One full single transparent RGBA sprite, no ground/shadow/text/effects. Target GPT Image2.5 Sunburst/max; actual tool selectors unavailable.
